title: GAUSSIAN FLUCTUATIONS OF JACK-DEFORMED RANDOM YOUNG DIAGRAMS
abstract: We introduce a large class of random Young diagrams which can be regarded as a natural one-parameter deformation of some classi- cal Young diagram ensembles; a deformation which is related to Jack polynomials and Jack characters. We show that each such a random Young diagram converges asymptotically to some limit shape and that the ﬂuctuations around the limit are asymptotically Gaussian.
